descriptions.preferred: This cultivar has dark black-red foliage when in its prime in the early season. It may bronze out with greenish undertones later in the season, especially in full sun. The leaf has five, or sometimes seven, lobes, widely separated, verynarrow,anddividedcompletelytothebase.Themidrib of each lobe is green. The lobes of leaves on mature Corvallis plant might be classed as a tall shrub rather than a small tree, reaching a height of 4 m. rhs.description: A graceful small, deciduous tree about 3.m tall, with delicate slender-lobed, ribbon-like leaves, dark red when young, aging to bronze-green in summer then turning red and orange in autumn; ideal for bonsai training

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants, Wildlife Gardens
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this linearilobum group have long, narrow, strap-like lobes, with lightly serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Ideal for container cultivation and bonsai training. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 此 linearilobum 组的槭树具有细长、带状的裂片，叶缘具浅锯齿。
attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、庭院/容器植物、野生动物友好型花园

care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保湿性好且排水良好的土壤中，并置于避风环境。叶色在半阴条件下表现最佳；如土壤能稳定保持湿润，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴晒过度都可能导致叶片灼伤。非常适合容器栽培和盆景整形。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 姿态优雅的小型落叶乔木，高约 3 米；叶片纤细狭裂，呈带状，新叶深红色，夏季逐渐转为铜绿色，秋季变为红色与橙色；非常适合制作盆景

descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种在生长季早期状态最佳时，叶色呈深黑红色。季节后期可能转为带绿色底调的古铜色，尤其是在全日照条件下更为明显。叶片有 5 裂，有时 7 裂，裂片分离较大，极狭长，并一直深裂至叶基。每个裂片的中脉为绿色。Corvallis 栽培的成熟植株，其叶裂片可能会被归为 Linearilobum Group 中较高大的灌木状类型，而非小乔木，高度可达 4 m。它是一个非常优良的类型，与 Linearilobum Group 中冠形更圆的品种，如 'Red Pygmy' 和 'Villa Taranto'，形成鲜明对比。'Atrolineare' 还曾以 'Akano-hichi gosan'、
